name: dlsite-scraper
description: Scrape DLsite (DLsite.com) — Japan's largest doujin marketplace. Extract product data, search results, rankings, and category listings for voice, ASMR, games, manga, and music. Features: keyword search, ranking scraping (daily/weekly/monthly/total), product detail by ID, category browsing, and filters by work type. Unique data: circle/brand names, voice actors, download counts, ratings, file info, release dates, and prices.
author: Atushi
